p: Hanley is the main city centre of Stoke-on-Trent, and Percy Street is right in the middle of things, close to the Potteries Centre and the bus station.

If you've never had a proper look round, the Potteries Museum and Art Gallery is a short walk away, packed with ceramics and home to part of the Staffordshire Hoard. The Regent Theatre and the Victoria Hall host touring shows and concerts. Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, which means strictly 18+. And while you're in the Potteries, don't leave without trying a Staffordshire oatcake, the local favourite, filled with cheese, bacon or sausage.
